Ulta Beauty, Inc. Appoints Patricia Little to its Board of Directors. Ulta Beauty, Inc. announced that Patricia Little, former Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of The Hershey Company has been appointed to its Board of Directors effective November 27, 2019. Ms. Little joins the Ulta Beauty board with more than 30 years of professional financial and leadership experience. Patricia retired from her role as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of The Hershey Company in 2019. Prior to joining Hershey, Patricia was the Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer at Kelly Services, Inc. and spent 24 years with Ford Motor Company holding a variety of leadership roles. Ms. Little holds a B.S. from Drake University and an MBA from Carnegie Mellon University. Ms. Little currently serves as a member of the Board of Directors of McCormick & Company, Inc. and is the chair of its Audit Committee.

Ulta Beauty, Inc. Revises Earnings Guidance for the Fiscal Year 2019; to Open Approximately 80 New Stores. Ulta Beauty, Inc. revised earnings guidance for the fiscal year 2019. For the year, the company expected increase of total sales by approximately 10% (previously between 9% and 12%). The company expected to deliver diluted earnings per share in the range of $11.93 to $12.03 (previously $11.86 to $12.06).The company expected to open approximately 80 new stores, execute approximately 20 remodel or relocation projects, and complete approximately 270 store refreshes.
